## Load Packages

```{r}
setwd("~/R Studio/NSAS Herring/NSAS-Herring")

library(bcp)
library(changepoint)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(FSA)
library(strucchange)
library(MASS)
library(hydroGOF)
library(mgcv)
library(INDperform)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(progress)
library(segmented)
library(FLCore)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Import data

```{r}
load("data/Herring_LAI.Rdata")

### Load functions from "functions"
source("R/functions.R")

### Split data into components
Herring <- list()
Herring$SHOR <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Shetland_Orkney",]
Herring$Buchan <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Buchan",]
Herring$Banks <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Banks",]
Herring$Downs <- Herring_LAI[Herring_LAI$component == "Downs",]

Herring_LAI <- NULL
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### Call function "changepoint_analysis" from functions

### Shetland Orkney
results_cpt <- list()
results_cpt$SHOR <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, 
                                          region_name = "Shetland/Orkney",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  12,   19,   23,   25,   34,   43 
# CPT changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 1994, 1996, 2005, 2014 

# BCP changepoint indices:  12,   19,   23,   31,   34,   43 
# BCP changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 1994, 2002, 2005, 2014 

# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1983, 1990, 2005, 2014 
# CPT only: 1994, 1996 
# BCP only: 1994, 2002

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
results_cpt$Buchan <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Buchan, 
                                          region_name = "Buchan",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  15,   18,   22,   38,   40,   47 
# CPT changepoint years:    1986, 1989, 1993, 2009, 2011, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  18,   21,   23,   39,   46 
# BCP changepoint years:    1989, 1992, 1994, 2010, 2017 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1989, 2009, 2018 
# CPT only: 1986, 1993, 2011 
# BCP only: 1992, 1994, 2010, 2017

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
results_cpt$Banks <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Banks, 
                                          region_name = "Banks",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  11,   19,   29,   34,   38,   48 
# CPT changepoint years:    1982, 1990, 2000, 2005, 2009, 2019 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  12,   19,   29,   30,   34 
# BCP changepoint years:    1983, 1990, 2000, 2001, 2005 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1982, 1990, 2000, 2005 
# CPT only: 2009, 2019 
# BCP only: 1983, 2001

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
results_cpt$Downs <- changepoint_analysis(Herring$Downs, 
                                          region_name = "Downs",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.7)
# CPT changepoint indices:  16,   28,   30,   40,   44,   49 
# CPT changepoint years:    1987, 1999, 2001, 2011, 2015, 2020 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  30,   40 
# BCP changepoint years:    2001, 2011 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 2001, 2011 
# CPT only: 1987, 1999, 2015, 2020  
```

## Plot change-points

```{r}
### Shetland Orkney
plots_SSB_cpt <- list()
plots_SSB_cpt$SHOR <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring$SHOR, 
              changepoints = results_cpt$SHOR$consensus$changepoint_years,
              component = "Shetland / Orkney", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component",

plots_SSB_cpt$SHOR

              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component",

plots_SSB_cpt$Buchan

              component = "Banks", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plots_SSB_cpt$Banks

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
plots_SSB_cpt$Downs <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring$Downs, 
              changepoints = results_cpt$Downs$consensus$changepoint_years,
              component = "Downs", 
              SSB_column = "SSB_component", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd_component", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd_component", 
              show_hlines = FALSE)
plots_SSB_cpt$Downs
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_components.png"),
       plot = grid.arrange(
         plots_SSB_cpt$SHOR + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Buchan + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Banks + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         plots_SSB_cpt$Downs + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()),
         ncol = 2,
         bottom = "Year",
         left = "SSB in million t"),
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Examine for time lag
ccf(Herring$SHOR$SSB_component, Herring$SHOR$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag
Herring$SHOR$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$SHOR$SSB_component, 1)

ccf(Herring$Buchan$SSB_component, Herring$Buchan$F, type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring$Buchan$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Buchan$SSB_component, 3)

ccf(Herring$Banks$SSB_component, Herring$Banks$F, type = "correlation") # 5 years lag
Herring$Banks$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Banks$SSB_component, 5)

ccf(Herring$Downs$SSB_component, Herring$Downs$F, type = "correlation") # 1 year lag
Herring$Downs$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring$Downs$SSB_component, 1)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------
### Call function "breakpoint_analysis"

### Shetland Orkney
results_brkpt <- list()
results_brkpt$SHOR <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, "SSB_component", "F", "year",
                                               lag_years = 1,
                                               region_name = "Shetland Orkney")

# Optimal number of breaks: 5 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.28 0.29 0.189 0.29 0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1983, 1990, 1997, 2005, 2015
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
results_brkpt$Buchan <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Buchan, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Buchan")
# Optimal number of breaks: 3
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.29 0.189 0.184 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1990, 1997, 2012 
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Banks
results_brkpt$Banks <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Banks, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 5, 
                                    region_name = "Banks")
# Optimal number of breaks: 2
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.39 0.29 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1988, 2005 
#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Downs
results_brkpt$Downs <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring$Downs, "SSB_component", "F", "year", 
                                    lag_years = 1, 
                                    region_name = "Downs")
# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.41 0.171 0.073 0.24 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1987, 2002, 2009, 2016 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis 
plots_hysteresis <- list()

plots_hysteresis$SHOR <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$SHOR, results_brkpt$SHOR$break_years, "Shetland Orkneys", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$SHOR

plots_hysteresis$Buchan <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Buchan, results_brkpt$Buchan$break_years, "Buchan", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Buchan

plots_hysteresis$Banks <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Banks, results_brkpt$Banks$break_years, "Banks", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Banks

plots_hysteresis$Downs <- plot_hysteresis(Herring$Downs, results_brkpt$Downs$break_years, "Downs", show_msy_btrigger = FALSE)
plots_hysteresis$Downs
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Load model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

### Shetland Orkney
#### Compare different models
models_SRR <- list()

models_SRR$SHOR <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$SHOR,
  recruit_col = "Recruitment",
  ssb_col = "SSB_component",
  max_breaks = 5,
  use_bic = TRUE)

print(models_SRR$SHOR$comparison_table)
#               Model          AIC     RMSE R_squared
#        independence 1.795652e+03  7197567 0.3897771
#       beverton_holt 1.138750e+02  8004318 0.3220916
#              ricker 1.152775e+02  7902179 0.3149778
#   segmented_regular 1.791667e+03  6665647 0.4766386
#       segmented_log 1.124631e+02 14069690 0.4168969
#  segmented_negbinom 1.758980e+03  6990494        NA
#         strucchange 1.743655e+03  3889912 0.8217635
#        glm_gaussian 1.795652e+03  7197567        NA
#         glm_poisson 2.137039e+08  6957747        NA
#    glm_quasipoisson           NA  6957747        NA
#        glm_negbinom 1.763447e+03  6955796        NA

##### strucchange lowest RMSE.

### Prep data for LOOCV function
dat_SHOR <- Herring$SHOR %>%
  mutate(R_log = log(Recruitment),
         SSB_log = log(SSB_component)) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, Recruitment, SSB_component, R_log, SSB_log) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  setNames(c("Year", "R", "SSB", "R_log", "SSB_log")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

### Call function "cross_valid" for performing loocv for all models
rmse_mean_SHOR <- cross_valid(dataset = dat_SHOR)
#         linear    beverton    ricker      segmented   seg.log     segm.glm    strucchange
# TEST:   6032494   5917938     5996407     5906258     5705905     5919392     10051737
# TRAIN:  7193145   7998380     7896592     6659682     6947653     6985389     3945464

#### strucchange validated by loocv.

### Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis" to extract SSR breakpoints
results_SRR <- list()
results_SRR$SHOR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring$SHOR, "SSB_component", "Recruitment", "year", "Shetland Orkney")

# Optimal number of breaks: 3 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 148853.8, 505309.4, 1201916.7 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1980, 1987, 2001 

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

### Buchan
#### Compare different models
models_SRR$Buchan <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring$Buchan,
  recruit_col = "Recruitment",
  ssb_col = "SSB_component",
  max_breaks = 5,
```

# tGAM

```{r}
### Load env and cpr data
load("data/env_df_subset.Rdata")
load("data/cpr_component.Rdata")

### Call "run_threshold_analysis" from functions and extract results (below)
results_tgam <- list()
#### SHOR
results_tgam$SHOR <- run_threshold_analysis(Herring$SHOR, 
                                            cpr_component, 
                                            env_df_subset, 
                                            region_name = "Shetland_Orkney",
                                            aggregation_mode = "autumn", 
                                            test_variables = c("Mean_SST", "Mean_SBT", "Mean_SSS"))

#  Variable  n edf_before edf_after p_value_min Threshold Threshold_accepted
#  Mean_SST 31      0.667     0.799       0.043      11.6    No tGAM (LOOCV)
#  Mean_SBT 31      0.667     0.713       0.018      10.0    No tGAM (LOOCV)
#  Mean_SSS 31      0.667     0.614       0.004      35.1    No tGAM (LOOCV)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------

#### Buchan
results_tgam$Buchan <- run_threshold_analysis(Herring$Buchan,
```
